text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I returned to the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whether an Umamusume is hailed as a legend
or praised for defining an era,
opinions will always vary."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "For example... the first-ever Classic Triple Crown Umamusume in history, hailed as a sacred light shining upon the racing world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Surpassing that girl with 5 GⅠ victories. Revered as a 'myth' for her long-lasting influence on the racing world, she—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. was watching TV.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome back, Trainer.
Good timing. Let's watch together.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: A talk show featuring a Triple Crown Umamusume, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And Symboli Rudolf—with her strength and lofty ideals, she too is sure to be one of those who will shape the era to come."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where she pointed, a talk show was starting
with the on-screen caption reading,
"Special Guest: Symboli Rudolf."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She might just become an entity that transcends myths
and brings absolute certainty to the racing world."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then! And so, joining us today is none other
than the undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume,
Symboli Rudolf!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: "Without further ado... Now that you've become a glorious Triple Crown Umamusume, I imagine all eyes are on you more than ever!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling pressure right now, by any chance...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I see this level of attention
as an opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I've had more opportunities to be invited to studios
and do interviews."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I am grateful to be given
an opportunity to speak to them like this.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: When you say "them," you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf smoothly shifted
her gaze toward the camera.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "—You there."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"You, who have lost sight of your own way of running.
You, who have lost the dream you should be chasing."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"You who grew sick of running.
You who felt your limits and sought to leave the turf behind."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Will you wait for the moment I reign at the pinnacle?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Will you wait for me
until the day I become a new legend?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will change the racing world. I will create a world
where no Umamusume ever leaves in despair.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To guide all Umamusume toward happiness.
That is why I shall become the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Rudolf.
She truly is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Some girls might call an ambition like that arrogant.
That's just how crazy of a dream it is.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yet Rudolf managed to make it all the way here.
Heading straight forward, honestly piling up victory after victory.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Half-hearted resolve won't get you through this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"A match against an Umamusume with such strong willpower...
It's bound to have an exquisite flavor."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Symboli Rudolf's words that day became a hot topic across all media for quite some time...
Then, one day, an unexpected visitor arrived."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for dropping by so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However, there is one thing I just can't get off my mind.
Um…… it's about C.B.-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sensing an unusual atmosphere, I invited them into the trainer's office for now
to hear the full story."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Actually... while doing my reporting,
there's a story I've been hearing quite a lot lately.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf is the new legend itself!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I think so too—she's going to be
someone who carves out a brand new era!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Indeed, your achievements this year in particular have been remarkable, leaving behind a track record truly befitting a champion!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, everyone was going wild over Mr. C.B. last year,
but now...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: CB is an extraordinary Umamusume in her own right!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"It was a bit disappointing, though,
that Symboli Rudolf debuted just one year later..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Their stances are complete opposites.
C.B. is amazing, but she doesn't race just to win.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: A race where we go all out for the win, huh...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who create legends that go down in history
really are on a whole other level...
That's certainly how it felt to me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Whatever dreams one sees in racing is up to the spectator.
I would never criticize that."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It's just that I've been hearing this so much lately, and I was worried CB-san might be getting troubled by it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, the spectators around were quite disappointed at the previous athletic meet... but she didn't seem to care in the slightest.
choice_data_list: As for her herself, not really...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, if CB-san ever finds herself
troubled in the future,
could you please let her know?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
There certainly are those opinions, but there are also
many fans who truly love CB-san's style of racing.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: “If the reporter says so, there's no doubt about it,” she said.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After Reporter Otonashi left the Trainer's office,
I folded my arms, wondering what to do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Should I tell them just in case?
Even if I do, they probably won't care, but how should I even bring it up—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, Trainer.
I already heard you."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
See, I have good hearing.
Don't worry about it, though. It doesn't bother me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I run only for myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, especially since entering the Senior Class,
a clear rift has formed between what she seeks from races and what those around her expect of her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even for a free spirit like Mr. C.B., there's no guarantee she can remain unbothered forever.
choice_data_list: We can come up with any number of countermeasures.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even just clearly presenting our stance should have some effect. When I suggested this—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No. Anyone's free to dream.
I don't have any right to stop them.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Besides, no matter what anyone around me says,
I'm never gonna change.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"If it's not fun for me,
then racing has no meaning."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I will never let anyone take it away.
It's okay."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At those words... suddenly,
words heard long ago came rushing back.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —She said that no matter what happens, she runs as her heart desires.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I won't let anyone take it away, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had made that decision before enrolling.
In other words, she had remained completely unchanged, staying true to a single conviction all along.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... whenever the fans placed different expectations on her
and I grew worried—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. clearly answered, "Just running freely."
choice_data_list: Sorry... That's just the kind of Umamusume you are.
Sorry... That's just the kind of Umamusume you are.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Why are you apologizing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At this point, there was likely no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "...You were the one who stripped away that very last drop of naivety I had."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You promised, remember?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I told you, no matter what happens, I'll keep
on being the Mr. C.B. you dream of.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens,
I'll keep on being the Mr. C.B. you dream of.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I promise.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Because of that... I was able to grow a lot stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If I remember correctly, those were the words Mr. C.B. promised me back when I began running in the Classic tier.
choice_data_list: Did that promise mean that much to you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined it could hold
such important meaning.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
I told you, didn't I? It's special.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I hate making promises.
I don't like being tied down.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...What, did you only just realize how amazing it is?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing me completely stunned, Mr. C.B. let out a lighthearted laugh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
âIt's true that compared to Symboli Rudolf,
her perspective might not be as broad.
She might lack that sense of stability, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, she never compromises herself no matter what,
believes in herself, and runs her races
exactly the way she wants to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why my heart flutters, and why I want to dream big through her races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while going forward, Symboli Rudolf may
continue to receive higher praise, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To me, Mr. C.B. is the one and only Umamusume
capable of defining an entire era."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Surely there must be
quite a few fans who feel the same way."
